scope: Node/actual production protocol functions and localization; no browser or live admin API

cases.name: empty and combined report filters use only the two UUID query parameters
malformed filters cannot add query fields or invoke another path
evidence route binds both the exact object and report
duplicate query, extra parameters and fragments are rejected
foreign, absolute and traversal media addresses never receive current auth
selected attachments bind the exact report and message without extra query
detail refuses a different report or any whole-conversation declaration
unavailable selected messages strip stale body, metadata and attachment URL
unavailable evidence strips even an old valid media URL
negative sizes, forged hashes and duplicate objects are rejected
selected content versions retain canonical decimal string semantics
PNG JPEG and MP4 signatures can be previewed with matching declared kinds
HTML SVG unknown bytes and declared media mismatch are never rendered
image and video bounds preserve the valid 32-to-64MiB video range
all ten admin-report locales contain the same eleven nonempty keys
the existing MFA apply and unknown-result retry flow remains byte-identical
